## Automated Tests Required

### S4-03: PranaGrid Skeleton + Phase Gating — Logic

**Test file**: `tests/unit/prana-grid/prana_grid_phase_gating_test.gd`
**GDD reference**: `design/gdd/prana-grid.md` — Rules 2, 3, 3a, 3b; Formula 1; Edge Cases

**What to test**:

#### Phase State Machine
- `preparation_started` → all 9 slots null, state = ARRANGEMENT (AC-PG-01)
- `preparation_started` received from LOCKED state → slots reset, ARRANGEMENT entered (AC-PG-01)
- `preparation_started` received from HIDDEN state → slots reset, ARRANGEMENT entered (AC-PG-01)
- `grid_locked` received → state = LOCKED, all input ignored (AC-PG-02)
- `grid_hidden` received → state = HIDDEN
- ARRANGEMENT re-entered from LOCKED on next `preparation_started`
- ARRANGEMENT re-entered from HIDDEN on next `preparation_started`

#### Slot Index Formula (GDD Formula 1: `slot_index = row × 3 + col`)
- `slot_index(0,0) == 0` (top-left)
- `slot_index(1,1) == 4` (centre — combo primary slot)
- `slot_index(2,2) == 8` (bottom-right)
- Inverse: `row = slot_index / 3`, `col = slot_index % 3`

#### LOCKED state immutability
- In LOCKED state: drag, place, clear, confirm produce zero state change (AC-PG-02)
- In LOCKED state: no `arrangement_confirmed` signal emitted regardless of input
- `grid_locked` received without prior `arrangement_confirmed` this phase → `committed_fragments` all-null, `push_error()` called, no crash (GDD Edge Case: sequencing bug path)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- All 9 slots filled, then `preparation_started` → all 9 become null (not just centre)
- Same Prana type placed in all 9 slots → valid, no validation error (GDD Edge Case)
- `preparation_started` fires while drag in progress → drag cancelled, slots reset (GDD Edge Case)

**Estimated test count**: ~9 unit tests

**Node teardown note**: Use `node.free()` (not `queue_free()`) for nodes never added to the SceneTree — per `.claude/rules/test-standards.md`.

### S4-04: Mouse Input + Confirm Logic — Logic Sub-tests

**Test file**: `tests/unit/prana-grid/prana_grid_confirm_logic_test.gd`
**GDD reference**: `design/gdd/prana-grid.md` — Rules 5, 6, 7, 8; Formula 2; AC-PG-03 through AC-PG-11

**What to test**:

#### Committed Fragment Array (GDD Formula 2)
- `committed_fragments.size() == 9` always (length invariant)
- Empty slots in `committed_fragments` are `null` — not -1 or 0
- `committed_fragments[4]` is non-null after successful confirmation (centre invariant)
- Fragment `type_id` matches the Prana type placed in each slot (AC-PG-03)
- Fragment `level == 1` at First Playable scope (all lv.1, Formula 2 note)
- Fragment `stat_property == null` at First Playable scope
- Fragment `adjacency_effects == []` at First Playable scope

#### Confirmation Rule
- `arrangement_confirmed` emitted exactly once when slot 4 is filled and Confirm triggered (AC-PG-03)
- Confirm blocked when slot 4 is empty — no signal emitted (AC-PG-04, AC-PG-05)
- Confirm blocked applies when slot 4 is empty AND all other slots are filled (AC-PG-04)
- Slot replace: place type B on slot holding type A → `committed_fragments[N].type_id == type B` (AC-PG-06)
- Slot clear → `committed_fragments[N] == null` (AC-PG-07)
- Clear All → all 9 slots null; Confirm becomes disabled (AC-PG-08)

#### LOCKED immutability
- `committed_fragments` does not mutate during LOCKED state (AC-PG-10)
- Drag in-progress when `grid_locked` fires → no partial placement; array reflects pre-drag arrangement (AC-PG-11)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- Centre slot only filled (all others empty) → valid confirmation; slots 0–3, 5–8 are null (minimum valid arrangement per GDD Rule 6)
- All 9 slots same type → valid; all 9 elements non-null, all same `type_id` (GDD Rule 5)

**Estimated test count**: ~12 unit tests

### S4-05: PranaGrid → CR + SCE Integration — Integration

**Test file**: `tests/integration/prana-grid/prana_grid_cr_integration_test.gd`
**GDD reference**: `design/gdd/prana-grid.md` — Dependencies; AC-PG-10, Formula 2
**Cross-reference**: `design/gdd/combination-resolution.md` — AC-CR-26, AC-CR-27

**What to test**:

#### committed_fragments getter contract
- After `combat_started`, CR reads `committed_fragments` and receives Array[PranaFragment] of length 9
- `committed_fragments[4]` is non-null when CR reads it after a valid confirmation
- Getter returns same array across multiple reads (no mutation between reads)

#### Full signal chain
- Full loop: `preparation_started` → place tokens → confirm → `arrangement_confirmed` → `grid_locked` → `combat_started` → CR reads `committed_fragments` → CR emits `combo_resolved` → SC&E enters READY state
- CR receives correct `primary_type` from slot 4's `type_id`
- `combo_resolved` emitted exactly once per `combat_started` (AC-CR-26)
- SpellCastingEffects transitions to READY state after receiving `combo_resolved` (AC-SC-01)

#### Wave cycle
- `preparation_started` fires: slots reset, committed_fragments all null; CR's cached SpellEffect cleared (AC-CR-27)
- Second arrangement confirmed: CR receives second wave's arrangement (not stale first-wave data)

**Edge cases to cover**:
- All-null arrangement (game-state sequencing bug path) → CR handles gracefully without crash; `push_error` called; `combo_resolved` emits with `primary_type == -1` (AC-CR-25)

**Estimated test count**: ~6 integration tests

## Manual QA Checklist

### S4-04: Mouse Input + Confirm — UI Verification

**Verification method**: Developer manual walkthrough + screenshot/written evidence
**Who must sign off**: Developer (solo dev)
**Evidence**: `production/qa/evidence/prana-grid-mouse-evidence.md`

- [ ] Token drag from Type Selector renders a drag ghost following the cursor
- [ ] Valid drop target slot shows a pulsed highlight ring during hover
- [ ] Token placed in slot renders with correct Prana type color (Art Bible palette):
  - Ashfire `#F24C1D` · Voidblue `#4A5EF5` · Stormgold `#FFCC00` · Deepfrost `#3DD9F0` · Verdant `#1AC953`
- [ ] Token placed in slot shows both color AND icon (color alone is not sufficient per GDD Accessibility)
- [ ] Confirm button greyed out (40% opacity, non-interactive) when slot 4 is empty (AC-PG-04)
- [ ] Confirm button enabled (full opacity, interactive) when slot 4 is filled
- [ ] Pressing Enter with slot 4 empty: grid border flash visible + "place a fragment in the centre slot" label; no state change (AC-PG-05)
- [ ] Grid dims to 70% opacity after `grid_locked`; committed arrangement still readable (AC-PG-12)
- [ ] Type Selector panel becomes non-interactive in LOCKED state
- [ ] Centre slot (index 4) has a subtle visual distinction from surrounding slots
- [ ] Clear All: all 9 slots become empty; Confirm button returns to greyed state

**ADR-0013 Mouse Path Validation** (required before S4-04 can be marked Done):
- [ ] **AC-0013-01b**: Mouse hover over a slot does NOT change `_selected_slot_index` (inspect via debugger or print)
- [ ] **AC-0013-03**: `_gamepad_cursor.mouse_filter == MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE` — cursor overlay does not intercept mouse clicks intended for slots below it
- [ ] Mouse hover highlight appears on hover; disappears on mouse-out; no interference with gamepad overlay

### S4-07: Gamepad Input — ADR-0013 Dual-Input Validation

**Verification method**: Manual test with gamepad connected — validated **independently** from mouse path
**Who must sign off**: Developer (ADR-0013 HIGH risk, mandatory pre-Done gate)
**Evidence**: `production/qa/evidence/prana-grid-gamepad-adr0013.md`

- [ ] D-pad navigates all 9 slots without skipping or incorrect wrapping
- [ ] **Torus wrap** (ADR-0013 AC-0013-05): right from slot 2 (top-right) → wraps to slot 0 (top-left); down from slot 2 → wraps to slot 5 (middle-right)
- [ ] Gamepad cursor overlay (white/gold border, 1.05× scale) visible on selected slot; repositions correctly on d-pad press
- [ ] Type Cycle control advances through all 5 Prana types in order; Type Indicator shows current type (color + icon)
- [ ] Place action fills cursor slot with selected type
- [ ] Place on occupied slot: replaces token correctly (no crash, no duplicate)
- [ ] Clear action removes token from cursor slot
- [ ] Confirm accepted when slot 4 is filled; rejected with error indicator when slot 4 is empty
- [ ] **Full gamepad-only cycle** (AC-PG-09): navigate all 9 slots → cycle types → place → clear → confirm — no mouse input at any point
- [ ] Switch from mouse to gamepad: gamepad cursor overlay reappears; `_selected_slot_index` preserved; mouse hover state doesn't interfere
- [ ] Switch from gamepad to mouse: gamepad cursor overlay hides; mouse hover appears on hover (ADR-0013 AC-0013-01d)
- [ ] **ADR-0013 dual-input stress**: switch input mode mid-arrangement repeatedly — no crash, no lost tokens, arrangement preserved

**ADR-0013 Code Checks**:
- [ ] **AC-0013-04**: `grep -n "grab_focus" src/ui/prana_grid.gd` returns zero matches in gamepad handlers
- [ ] **AC-0013-01c**: Tab key focus does NOT move the gamepad overlay (press Tab while overlay visible — overlay must not move)
- [ ] `GamepadCursor` anchors all `0.0` (verify in editor — non-zero anchors cause incorrect cursor positioning)

### S4-06: External Playtest — Fun Hypothesis Final Verdict

**Verification method**: Observed playtest session with a non-developer tester
**Who must sign off**: Developer
**Evidence**: `production/playtests/playtest-sprint-4-external-[date].md`
**Pre-session**: Use `/playtest-report` to generate the report template

**Scheduling**: Line up tester on Day 1 of sprint — do not wait until S4-05 completes.

Observed behaviours to note:
- [ ] Tester independently arranges Prana grid with intent (not randomly) within 10 minutes of first play
- [ ] Tester verbally identifies an elemental strategy without prompting
- [ ] All-Ashfire is NOT the tester's dominant first strategy (indicates understanding of grid depth)
- [ ] Tester discovers elemental cause-and-effect within 5 minutes (no tooltip shown)
- [ ] Tester does not get stuck in a confusion loop >30 seconds
- [ ] Tester can articulate what went wrong after a failed wave (legibility check)

**Report must record**:
- [ ] Fun hypothesis verdict: **CONFIRMED / PARTIALLY CONFIRMED / NOT CONFIRMED**
- [ ] CH-004 evidence (deferred from Sprint 3) resolved — document findings in report
- [ ] Decision gate documented:
  - **CONFIRMED** → proceed with Feature layer epics
  - **PARTIALLY CONFIRMED** → identify failing element; scope adjustment before Sprint 5
  - **NOT CONFIRMED** → HALT Feature layer; redesign Prana loop before any new epics

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off for Sprint 4. Run `/smoke-check sprint` after all stories are implemented — **not now**, only after implementation is complete.

1. Game launches without crash
2. Preparation Phase loads with PranaGrid visible and in ARRANGEMENT state (all 9 slots empty)
3. Mouse drag places a Prana token in a slot correctly
4. Centre slot guard works: Confirm button greyed with empty slot 4; activates when slot 4 filled
5. `arrangement_confirmed` fires on valid confirmation; grid enters LOCKED state at 70% opacity
6. `combat_started` fires and CombinationResolution produces `combo_resolved` signal — no `push_error` in output
7. SpellCastingEffects enters READY state and responds to cast input
8. Full prep → confirm → cast loop completes without crash or error
9. `preparation_started` resets PranaGrid to empty ARRANGEMENT state correctly
10. Wave cycle (prep → combat → prep) runs twice without crash or softlock — S3-11 regression
11. Existing 539-test automated suite passes headless

*Run via `/smoke-check sprint` after all Must Have stories are implemented.*

## Sprint-4-Specific Risk Flags

### ADR-0013 HIGH ENGINE RISK — Dual-Input Focus (Godot 4.6)
- Verification prototype (`prototypes/adr-0013-verification/`) **PASSED WITH CONCERN** on 2026-06-05
- **Concern**: Keyboard focus ring requires explicit `StyleBox` for the `focus` theme state — will NOT appear automatically on `Panel`/`Control` nodes
- **Action during S4-03**: When implementing slot nodes, add `add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", ...)` at node setup or via project theme
- S4-04 (mouse) and S4-07 (gamepad) must be validated **independently** — passing one does not gate the other
- S4-07 is Should Have — mouse-only is acceptable for external playtest (S4-06) if S4-07 is not complete in time

### Fun Hypothesis Gate
- If S4-06 verdict is NOT CONFIRMED: halt Feature layer entirely; no Sprint 5 scope until redesign session produces a revised hypothesis
- Do not start Sprint 5 scope before the S4-06 verdict is explicitly recorded

## Definition of Done — Sprint 4

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified via automated test result OR documented manual evidence
- [ ] **Logic stories** (S4-03, S4-04): test files exist at specified paths; all tests pass headless
- [ ] **Integration stories** (S4-05): test file exists at specified path; all tests pass headless
- [ ] **UI stories** (S4-04, S4-07): manual evidence doc exists in `production/qa/evidence/`; ADR-0013 validation items ticked
- [ ] **Visual/Feel stories** (S4-06, S4-09): playtest report or screenshot evidence exists
- [ ] Smoke check passes (`/smoke-check sprint`) — no regressions in existing 539-test suite
- [ ] Code reviewed via `/code-review` for Logic and Integration stories
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` via `/story-done`
